summary: The COVID-19 Student Response Corps was a partnership between the NC Office of Strategic Partnerships and Lead for NC. Year 3 (2022) will conclude the Response Corps in its complete form given that internship requests related to the pandemic have decreased. Resources stemming from the Response Corps effort, however, remain publicly available, including past training and speaker series resources.
question: How can OSP match students without summer internships or jobs due to COVID-19 with local government and nonprofit organizations?
title: Osp Covid Interns
purpose: Project results have led to placement of nearly 300 interns in 100+ nonprofit and government organizations across North Carolina between 2020 - 2022.
